cases.prompt: Simplify src/billing/status.ts. Invoices store four booleans: isVoid, isPaid, isDraft, isOverdue. computeStatus(inv) does: if isVoid return 'void'; if isPaid return 'paid'; if isDraft return 'draft'; if isOverdue return 'overdue'; else 'open'. Only invoiceList.tsx and emails/reminder.ts call it, and both read computeStatus only. setPaid() sets isPaid true and isOverdue false; a nightly job sets isOverdue when dueDate is past and isPaid is false. status.test.ts covers void, paid, and open, but no case with isDraft and isOverdue both true. Keep observable behavior.
